name: Misato (Akita, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Misato town emblem in white: a stylised brush stroke like a letter Z with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Misato, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Misato town emblem — a stylised brush stroke like a letter Z with a small disc
